file_roles.evidence: '#include "moc_qtestlog_p.cpp"' moved from before QT_END_NAMESPACE to after it, so the moc file's std headers (<memory>) are no longer included inside namespace RTA.

rationale: With -qtnamespace the build broke because the moc include pulled standard library headers into the Qt namespace ('move' is not a member of 'RTA::std'). The diff moves the include outside the namespace, which is the wrong placement being corrected. The error is raised from qtestlog.cpp line 600 per the log.
